The '''323rd Imperial TIE Bomber Group''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] group whose [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] flew [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]].

==Description==
The 323rd Imperial flew [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] that were [[Color/Legends|colored]] with the standard [[Color/Legends|gray]] of the Empire. Armed with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]], were configured to sacrifice maneuverability for increased destructive payload delivery to enemy targets, in contrast to their contemporaries, the [[276th Imperial TIE Bomber Group|276th Imperial]].<ref name="Mini">{{PocketModel|set=Ground Assault|cardname=323rd Imperial TIE bomber|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipga03a.jpg}}</ref>
